newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fokus Bank downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fokus Bank downgraded.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities said on Monday it had downgraded its rating for Norway's Fokus Bank to market performer from buy.

-- "We expect greater stock appreciation for Fokus Bank from the current levels. Our Fokus downgrade assumes that the 16 percent overall return that we expect from the stock will be insufficient to cause it to outperform the Norwegian market by more than five percent," analysts Catherine Woods and Haakon Boenes wrote in a report.

-- "We expect the erosion of the net interest margin to continue for another two quarters. The new sustainable margin level is likely to be lower than we had previously anticipated, once the competition abates."
